questions.question: A wise Teacher said all labor and success spring from what?

answers.text: A man's envy of his neighbor
A man's love for his family
A man's fear of going hungry

questions.question: A wise Teacher said two people are better than one. What reason did he give?

answers.text: They have a good return for their labor
They are safe from their neighbor's envy
They never have to work very hard

questions.question: A wise Teacher said a cord of three strands is quickly broken. True or false?
A wise Teacher said who is better than an old king who no longer knows how to take a warning?
